thread:
rachel_platform: Quick sync — we need to agree on the EXACT KV / prefix cache metrics for the new console widgets, and how those metrics affect routing/quotas and rollout UX. cc @maria_devex @ajenkins @sam_ml :eyes:

maria_devex: high level ask: dashboard needs per-route hit rate, eviction churn, and reuse-by-workload (so product can see which routes benefit most). Also want tenant-scoped views for Dedicated customers.

ajenkins: key constraint: cardinality. we can't tag by raw tenant_id. propose hashed_tenant, route, model_variant, workload_sig (low-cardinality). also set sampling at agent level.

sam_ml: question: how do we define workload_sig? my suggestion: (prefix_len_bucket, request_type, avg_seq_len_bucket). reuse_by_workload = distinct_prefixes_reused / distinct_prefixes_seen over a window. open to better defs.

metrics-bot: instrumentation note: new metric names pushed to staging: redwood_kv_cache_requests_total, redwood_kv_cache_hits_total, redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total, redwood_kv_prefix_reuse_counts, redwood_kv_prefix_seen_counts.

maria_devex: thanks. for console UX we want these items per-route and an overall aggregate: 1) 5m/1h/24h hit rate sparklines 2) eviction churn rate (evictions / minute) 3) workload reuse table (top 10 workload_sig by reuse%) 4) ability to filter by customer tier (hosted/dedicated/private).

ajenkins: runtime/infra ask: please keep metric cardinality to <= 100k series. suggested labels: route, hashed_tenant (coarse), model_variant, prefix_len_bucket. do local aggregations: export "route-level" aggregates from the node/agent to cut series.

sam_ml: alerts / policy note: routing fallback wants to trigger when per-route hit_rate drops AND evictions spike -> that indicates memory pressure, fallback to cheaper model or scale up. example alert (PromQL-ish):

```

100 * (1 - sum(increase(redwood_kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(increase(redwood_kv_cache_requests_total[5m]))) > 40 and
sum(increase(redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (route) > 50

```

then trigger routing policy to route to fallback_pool.

rachel_platform: UX/rollout note: we need a canary flag in console for "show new cache metrics" and a lightweight explainer for SREs. Rollout plan: instrument -> export route-level aggregates -> internal dashboard -> 1-week canary for infra/eng teams -> org-wide.

maria_devex: agree. timeline suggestion: instrument PRs this sprint, agent export changes + staging dashboards next sprint, canary for 1 week, GA after fixes. I'll mock dashboard tiles today.

ajenkins: infra work: I'll implement local aggregation + cardinality cap. need schema for labels and exact metric names. propose the following payload (agent -> ingest):

```
metric: redwood_kv_cache_route_agg
labels: {route, hashed_tenant, model_variant, prefix_len_bucket}
fields: {requests, hits, evictions, prefix_seen, prefix_reused}
export_interval: 60s
```

sam_ml: when computing reuse% remember to exclude very low-traffic routes (noise). use min_requests_threshold = 100 over 1h window. also we should record sample traces for a few request_ids so we can debug reuse patterns (no PII).

rachel_platform: ownership: ajenkins owns infra export, sam_ml owns definitions/semantics, maria_devex owns dashboard UX + rollout docs. I'll coordinate rollout and quotas team.

maria_devex: quick ask for the team: can we add an example query for "reuse_by_workload" for dashboard devs?

ajenkins: simple agg example (pseudo PromQL):

```
(sum by (route, workload_sig) (increase(redwood_kv_prefix_reuse_counts[1h]))) /
(sum by (route, workload_sig) (increase(redwood_kv_prefix_seen_counts[1h]))) * 100
```

sam_ml: perfect. i'll add workload_sig hash function and prefix_len buckets to the instrumentation doc.

rachel_platform: ok let's reconvene EOD Friday for a short demo of the staging widgets. +1 if you can make the timeline. :thumbsup:

ajenkins: +1
sam_ml: +1
maria_devex: +1 :rocket:
